name: Monkeytail
subtitle: HTTP, cURL & JSON Client
promotionalText: Native API debugging on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro. Send favourites on Apple Watch. Import cURL and sync with iCloud. Free. No Monkeytail account.
description:
Monkeytail is a native request debugger for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. The compact Apple Watch companion sends favourite requests copied from iPhone. No Monkeytail account or sign-in.

• Import cURL, Postman collections, Insomnia JSON, and OpenAPI or Swagger JSON/YAML.
• Organize nested folders with shared headers, authentication, variables, and JavaScript hooks.
• Use OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and refresh tokens, API keys, Basic, Bearer, and AWS Signature V4.
• Manage cookies and client certificates. Inspect request timings, redirects, and TLS details.
• Edit GraphQL queries and variables, browse schema fields, and inspect WebSocket or SSE messages.
• Format JSON, browse a tree, search, run visual response tests, and inspect images, audio, video, hex, or binary data.
• Save and compare responses, create offline mocks, and export Swift, JavaScript, Python, or Kotlin client code.
• Sync workspaces with optional iCloud Drive. Choose proxies. Browser TLS/HTTP2 profiles are available on iOS and Mac.

Free, with no in-app purchases, analytics, tracking, or data collection by Kitta Co. Requests go to servers and proxies you choose. Keychain storage is optional. Choose whether credentials join iCloud sync. Cookies, client certificates, and upload files remain on your device.

Requires iOS 17 or macOS 14 or later. Client certificate import on Mac requires macOS 15. Import, schema validation, and scripting support the documented subset.
reviewNotes: Monkeytail is an HTTP request debugger and development tool. No sign-in is required. Open a request and tap Send.
whatsNew: Cleaner collections with square rows, consistent spacing, and aligned actions. Compact Settings and optional Keychain storage.
visionOSDescription:
A native request debugger for Apple Vision Pro. Import cURL, edit headers and bodies, send requests, and inspect JSON, images, audio, video, or raw bytes.

Organize collections and environments. Import and export Monkeytail, Postman, Insomnia, and OpenAPI files. Use local JavaScript checks, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, response mocks, and saved snapshots.

Optional iCloud sync connects your existing Apple devices. No Monkeytail account. Free, with no in-app purchases and no data collected by Kitta Co.
whatsNew1_3: Favourites sync across your Apple devices. Copy favourite requests from iPhone to Apple Watch, then send, cancel, and inspect responses on your wrist. Native visionOS support is also available.
whatsNew1_4: Cleaner collections with square rows, consistent spacing, and aligned actions. Compact Settings and optional Keychain storage.
whatsNewMac1_4: Native Mac sidebar and search, one editable request title, a wider adjustable response pane, and improved environment controls. Optional Keychain storage.
